messages.subject: visual-diagnostics help
parts:
Hello all,

Can someone give a quick example of how to use the scripts in the visual-diagnostics project on Github?
I looked at the readme, but could not figure out how to specify the options to my cmdstan model to get the right output.

Thanks!

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] visual-diagnostics help
parts:
There are no options — you just specify the diagnostics file name,

> ./createAllDiagnostics <diagnostics_file_name>

Note that the scripts may be out of sync with the most recent versions
of Stan so no guarantee they’ll work out of the box.
